activities.activity_description: Analyze dependencies of ./core/chaincode/shim/ext/statebased, remove imports of fabric/comm, fabric/protoutil, pkg/errors, and transitive dependencies. Ensure only fabric protos remain. Update code, run tests, verify with go list.

Analyze dependencies of ./core/chaincode/shim/ext/entities, remove all fabric package imports and transitive dependencies. Ensure only protos or standard library remain. Update code, run tests, verify with go list.

Edit the marbles02_private chaincode example in fabric-samples: add comments explaining the need for `tr -d \\` and modify export commands to include `tr -d \\` to avoid JSON parsing errors on Windows. Test the updated commands in a Windows-like environment.

Design and initialize a new Go module `github.com/hyperledger/fabric-lib-go` with subdirectories for protoutil, bccsp, msp, discovery. Set up go.mod, CI/CD pipelines, release process, and basic documentation.

Extract protoutil package from Fabric into fabric-lib-go/protoutil. Remove internal dependencies, ensure it builds independently. Update Fabric to import from the new module. Run existing tests and add any missing unit tests.

Extract BCCSP (including sw, idemix, factory, etc.) into fabric-lib-go/bccsp. Refactor to eliminate internal Fabric dependencies. Update Fabric to depend on the new module. Ensure all cryptographic operations work correctly. Comprehensive testing required.
Extract MSP package into fabric-lib-go/msp. Remove dependencies on internal Fabric packages. Update Fabric to use the external module. Test identity management, signing, and verification flows.
Extract discovery client package into fabric-lib-go/discovery. Ensure it has no unwanted transitive dependencies. Update Fabric to import from the new module. Test service discovery functionality.
